# Built-in fallback faces, generated by tools/facegen/facegen.py build --update-fallback
# (CC0-1.0, D-019). Embedded in the app so the clock always has a face to show.
idf_component_register(SRCS "faces.c"
                       INCLUDE_DIRS "include"
                       REQUIRES etf
                       EMBED_FILES "fallback_135x240.etf" "fallback_80x160.etf")
